name: Umbreon
description: It is most active in the wee hours of the night, when moonlight bathes the land. Its large eyes can pierce the darkness and perceive prey with absolute clarity.

moves.name: Snarl
moves.description: The user attacks by crying out as if it's ranting about something. This also lowers the target's offensive stats.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.description: The user lunges at the target to deal damage, moving at a speed that makes it almost invisible. This also raises the user's action speed.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the target. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
moves.description: The user stares at the target with its baby-doll eyes. This lowers the target’s offensive stats.

moves.name: Mimic
moves.description: The user copies the target's last move. The move can be used during battle until the Pokémon is switched out.

moves.name: Dark Pulse
moves.description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with ill intent. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Calm Mind
moves.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its offensive and defensive stats.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless, life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user.
